name: Ink and Paper
description: Warm paper, ink text, a single vermilion accent. Serif headings with sans-serif body text, decoration limited to thin rules and colour blocks, no gradients or shadows.

ink.use: primary text; background of inverted pages

accent.use: the only accent: kicker, key numbers, CTA, dividers, list markers

display.family: 'Noto Serif TC', 'Songti TC', 'PMingLiU', 'Source Han Serif TC', Georgia, serif

body.family: 'Noto Sans TC', 'PingFang TC', 'Microsoft JhengHei', 'Source Han Sans TC', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif
